comments.author: Curious
comments.body: Very odd, I've never done this quest before but when I pulled it it said I had done it before. It looks like this quest gives you the same discovery as the "Coral Sea" quest does, just by looking at the quest info on here, which I guess explains why it shows I've done it. But why would two different quests give you the same discovery?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: That's because this quest involves re-discovering the Cayman Islands, which also doubles as the Coral Sea quest's discovery. In fact, you only need the Cayman Islands discovery in your logbook, and R11 Geography (plus maybe Dutch in case the language helps it generate more often) to pull the quest, and then Geo R11 for the conversation with Mercator; after that, R6 Geography is all you really need to finish the quest (since you are basically repeating "Coral Sea" for the last step). The Hunter job quest works the same way.
